verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local inference runtime and server (llama.cpp/MLX backends, OpenAI-like endpoints), so paged KV-cache memory management is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions paged attention, KV-cache paging, or fragmentation-free concurrent request handling. The only related controls documented are GPU offload and context-length flags on model load, which are adjacent settings and earn no credit.
